blocks.text: Archimedes' principle ke kuch important istemal yeh hain:

Hot-air balloon hawa mein is liye uthta aur tairta hai ke garam hawa wale balloon ki density aas paas ki hawa se kam hoti hai. Jab balloon par buoyant force (upthrust) us ke weight se zyada ho jaye to woh oopar uthne lagta hai. Balloon mein garam hawa ki quantity (kitni hawa hai) kam ya zyada kar ke yeh control kiya jata hai.
2. Pani par tairta lakri ka block

Lakri ka block pani par tairta hai, kyun ke block jitne volume ke pani ka weight block ke weight se zyada hai. Tairne ke principle ke mutabiq object tab tairta hai jab kuch hissa ya poora doobne par us ka hataya hua pani us ke weight ke barabar ho jaye.

Jahaz aur kashtiyan bhi isi tairne ke principle par banai jati hain. Yeh musafir aur saman pani par le jati hain. Agar musafiron aur saman samet jahaz ka weight pani ke upthrust se zyada ho jaye to woh doob jayega.
Submarine isi principle se pani ke oopar bhi chal sakti hai aur pani ke neeche bhi.

blocks.alt: Side se peeli submarine, us ke hisson tak lines: tower ke oopar periscope aur antenna, peechhe propeller, aage sonar aur hull (dhancha) par portholes (gol khirkiyon) ki qatar.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.10(b): Submarine (kitab ki Figure 5.10(b) ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Jab submarine ke volume ke barabar pani ka weight us ke apne weight se zyada ho to woh pani par tairti hai; us waqt woh jahaz jaisi hai aur us ka kuch hissa pani se oopar rehta hai. Us mein tanks hote hain jinhen samandar ke pani se bhara aur khali kiya ja sakta hai. Tanks mein pani bharne se submarine ka weight barhta hai. Jaise hi weight upthrust se zyada hota hai, submarine pani mein ghota lagati (dive karti) hai aur neeche rehti hai. Oopar aane ke liye tanks se pani nikal diya jata hai.

blocks.title: Example 5.3
blocks.problem: Ek khali meteorological (mausam napne wala) balloon ka weight 80 N hai. Is mein 10 cubic metre hydrogen bhari jati hai. Balloon apne weight ke ilawa zyada se zyada kitna saman utha sakta hai? Hydrogen ki density 0.09 kg m⁻³ aur hawa ki density 1.3 kg m⁻³ hai.
steps: Diya gaya: balloon ka weight w = 80 N; hydrogen ka volume V = 10 m³; hydrogen ki density ρ₁ = 0.09 kg m⁻³; hawa ki density ρ₂ = 1.3 kg m⁻³. Hydrogen ka weight w₁ = ?; saman ka weight w₂ = ?
Upthrust F = hatai hui hawa ka weight = ρ₂gV = 1.3 kg m⁻³ × 9.8 m s⁻² × 10 m³ = 127.4 N
Hydrogen ka weight w₁ = ρ₁Vg = 0.09 kg m⁻³ × 10 m³ × 9.8 m s⁻² = 8.82 N
Saman uthane ke liye kul weight upthrust F se zyada nahi hona chahiye: w + w₁ + w₂ = F
blocks.answer: Balloon apne weight ke ilawa taqreeban 38.6 N (kitab ke hisaab mein 38 N) saman utha sakta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki aakhri line kehti hai ke balloon 41 N utha sakta hai, magar usi solution mein w₂ = 127.4 − 80 − 8.82 = 38.58 N, yani taqreeban 38.6 N nikalta hai (kitab ne 38 N likha). Sahi jawab taqreeban 38.6 N hai, 41 N nahi. Kitab ki ek line (80 N + 8.82 N + w₁ = 127.4 N) mein w₂ ki jagah w₁ chhapa hai; wahan w₂ hona chahiye.

blocks.prompt: 600 kg m⁻³ density ka 10 kg lakri ka block pani par tair raha hai. Us par buoyant force kitni hai, aur block ka kitna hissa pani mein dooba hai? Patthar ka weight hawa ke muqable pani mein kam kyun lagta hai?
blocks.explanation: Tairti cheez apne weight ke barabar fluid hatati hai, is liye buoyant force = weight = 10 × 9.8 = 98 N. Doobe hisse ka volume = 98 / (1000 × 9.8) = 0.01 m³, jab ke block ka kul volume = 10/600 ≈ 0.0167 m³; is liye block ka 60% hissa dooba hai. Pani mein patthar par oopar ki taraf upthrust lagta hai jo us ke weight ka kuch hissa sambhal leta hai, is liye us ka weight hataye hue pani ke weight jitna kam lagta hai.

items: Upthrust = F₂ − F₁ = ρgA(h₂ − h₁) = ρgV = hataye hue liquid ka weight (Archimedes' principle).
Weight upthrust se zyada: doobta hai; barabar ya kam: tairta hai. Tairti cheez apne weight ke barabar fluid hatati hai (floatation); yeh gases par bhi lagu hai.
Istemal: hot-air balloon, lakri ka block, jahaz aur kashtiyan, submarine (tanks bhar kar ghota).
Example 5.2: 10 cm cube par 9.8 N. Example 5.3: balloon taqreeban 38.6 N uthata hai (kitab mein 38 N aur 41 N).
